Job Overview

Help build the AI-powered growth engine for the connected-vehicle industry. TrueDNA Telematics is building the next generation of vehicle intelligence—and we are looking for a highly entrepreneurial AI technology leader to build something equally important on the business side

Our vision is to create a system that can identify qualified fleet managers, rental-car operators, automotive dealers, fleet owners, and vehicle owners around the world; understand their likely needs; match them with the right TrueDNA solution; generate highly relevant communications; manage approved email/SMS workflows; learn from responses; qualify opportunities; and deliver high-value prospects to our sales organization.

TrueDNA Telematics, Inc. is an emerging technology company focused on delivering innovative telematics solutions that help organizations monitor, manage, and optimize their assets and operations. Based in Scottsdale, AZ, the company leverages data, connectivity, and automation to improve efficiency, safety, and decision-making for its customers. Team members collaborate across business and technical functions to develop scalable, customer-centric products and services. The environment is fast-paced and growth-oriented, offering opportunities to shape processes, build new capabilities, and contribute directly to the company’s long-term strategy.

Role Description

You will lead the architecture and development of the TrueDNA Global Growth Engine

The system should be able to: build an AI system that allows TrueDNA to reach the global vehicle ecosystem at a scale that a traditional sales organization cannot achieve.
